contract_plain_english: For a sound wave moving to the right in one space dimension at the positive sound speed c, the source uses a scalar wave variable w and models the wave by w_t + c w_x = 0. This is a scalar first-order hyperbolic equation. It is called a one-way wave equation because the sign and positive coefficient select one propagation direction, namely rightward at speed c. Mathematically it is the same constant-coefficient transport equation as advection equation (1.2), whose translated profiles depend on x - ct, although equation (1.4) itself leaves the exact pressure-velocity combination w abstract and does not state a complete all-solutions theorem.
